name: Bastard Brag
summary: A 3-card Brag variant where players improve hands by swapping with a central spare 3-card hand, one face-up.
rules_text: Deal 3 cards face down to each player and an extra 3-card hand to the table, two face down one face up. Ranking: prial (3-3-3 highest), running flush, run, flush, pair, high card, with 3-2-A high and suit tie-break spades>hearts>diamonds>clubs for lives game. Lives version: each player has 3 lives. Clockwise, on turn exchange one card with table (if you take face-up you must leave face-up, if face-down exchange is hidden) or swap whole hand for table hand turning one of yours face up. After first round you may knock to keep hand. After knock each other gets one final exchange. All show, worst hand loses a life, zero lives eliminated, last remains wins. Betting version: ante, two exchange rounds (first must exchange, second may pass), then Brag betting with raises until one remains or two-player pay-double-to-see.
rating_reason: Specific brag variant with exchange and betting
